newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's cyclone Rachel seen intensifying.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's cyclone Rachel seen intensifying.

text.p: A cyclone ripping through the Indian Ocean is expected to intensify later on Monday as it makes its way down the coast of Western Australia, the Bureau of Meteorology said.

At 0400 GMT (midday local), cyclone Rachel was estimated to be 200 km west of the coastal town of Broome and 300 km northeast of Port Hedland, traveling west-southwest at 15 km an hour, the bureau said.
The bureau earlier on Monday issued a warning for a category two-sized cyclone but now says it expects to upgrade Rachel to Category Three on Monday evening.
A Category Three cyclone carries winds between 170 and 224 kms an hour.
After crossing the coast on Saturday near Kalumburu, some 2,200 km north of Perth, Rachel partially dissipated before re-forming late on Sunday.
